bullets.text: AI Startups Surge - The **telco AI** market is set to explode from $2.66 billion to $50.21 billion by 2034.
Diverse 5G Strategies - **AT&T**, **Verizon**, and **T-Mobile** are adopting distinct approaches to 5G network infrastructure.
Cloud vs. Control - **AT&T** relies on **Microsoft** for its 5G core, while **Verizon** opts for a fully owned virtualised infrastructure.
